empty_group_mechanism.claim_source: code reading of FAST-LIVO2 src/LIVMapper.cpp sync_packages(), LIVO branch (lines ~1193-1335); not a new experiment
empty_group_mechanism.mechanism: LIVO mode alternates two cuts per processed frame. In the WAIT/VIO state it builds one MeasureGroup with the IMU samples in (last_lio_update_time, img_capture_time] and returns. The next call is in the LIO state, which clears meas.measures, builds a new MeasureGroup carrying only the image, and its IMU collection loop is commented out -- so that group is empty by construction. One GROUP row is written per package, hence exactly two per frame, one of which never contains IMU.
empty_group_mechanism.arithmetic_check: 1766 GROUP rows / 2 = 883 frames, and 884 empty rows -- the off-by-one is the initial frame before the image cut starts
empty_group_mechanism.correction_to_peer_reading: the earlier explanation ('adjacent lidar frames are close, so the previous frame already drained the IMU queue') is not what the code does: the empty group is not a timing race, it is the image-cut MeasureGroup whose IMU loop is commented out
empty_group_mechanism.consequence: the ~50% empty fraction is structural in LIVO mode and carries no anomaly signal; it should not be counted as missing IMU or as evidence about grouping
empty_group_mechanism.row_pairing: the rows come in pairs sharing one img_stamp: first the LIO-state cut (mesures=1, img=1, n_items=0, its IMU loop commented out), then the WAIT/VIO cut (mesures=2, n_items>0) that carries the IMU samples. Counts: 883 empty rows and 882 non-empty rows, plus the initial frame before the image cut starts
empty_group_mechanism.counting_rule: GROUP rows are not frames and there is no blanket division by two: the 1766 rows are 882 complete image events (an empty LIO-state row followed by a non-empty WAIT/VIO row sharing one img_stamp), plus one head row with img_stamp=-1 and one incomplete tail event. Count image events, GROUP rows and odometry separately; any count quoted must say which of the three it is
